title: How do I get 3d models?
author: CharacterUsual
selftext: I want custom 3d models, but I'll take just off the shelf ones...

comments.author: Amoner
comments.body: I used ChatGPT to create concept art of what I need, took that over to Meshy to get 3d models built and then took it over to Claude and Blender MCP to rig the models into actions

replies.author: MessageSelfdestructs
replies.body: What kind of question is this? Are you a toddler?

replies.author: CharacterUsual
replies.body: Why is it better than other options..?

comments.author: Entropydemic
comments.body:
I have been enjoy Tripo Ai. Mobile use and easy for beginners to follow. It even automatically gives models bones. Although, I haven't tried putting bones into a car model yet. Look at this, I made this with less than 1000 poly faces.

https://preview.redd.it/arslpasom2nh1.jpeg?width=720&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=4f1f27f5cb37f248aec4f08ce68cf4d6aeb95fd8

comments.author: monsterfurby
comments.body: Tripo and Meshy are the market leaders, though Tripo performed better for me so far on Reference from GPT-Image->Model Gen->Rig in Mixamo workflows.
